title.face_enrollment_subtitle: Allow the system to recognize you at check-in and check-out using your face.

dialog.reset_identification_description: Are you sure you want to remove your current face identification data?

description.general_info: Face enrollment helps the system verify that it is really you when you perform actions such as attendance check-in and check-out. Your face images are used only for recognition purposes inside the system.
description.re_enroll: You can re-enroll your face at any time if you feel that the system does not recognize you accurately.

1.title: 1. Face capture
1.description: When you start, the camera will capture your face for a short period of time to create a richer dataset.

2.title: 2. Image processing
2.description: The system converts your face images into numerical representations and stores them securely on the server.

3.title: 3. Recognition
3.description: When you check in or out, the system compares your live face data with the stored data to verify your identity.

description.illustration_note: This area can be replaced later with an illustration or short animation that explains face enrollment.

prompt.start_burst_mode: Click "Ready" to automatically capture for {durationSeconds} seconds.
prompt.start_single_mode: Click "Capture" to take a single face image.
prompt.preview: This is the last captured image. Do you want to keep it?

error.no_camera_access: Unable to access the camera. Please ensure that your device has a camera and that you have granted permission to use it.
error.enrollment_failed: Face enrollment failed. Please try again.
